structure.unit: Institutions of Higher Education; Other Educational and Cultural Institutions

law.catch_line: Exchange and cancellation of consol coupon bonds of the Commonwealth
law.text:
The following sections of the Code of Virginia of 1919 are continued in effect:
Section 991, relating to the exchange of consol coupon bonds held by colleges, etc., for funded registered consol bonds; and
Section 992, relating to the cancellation of such bonds surrendered in exchange.
